name: Dr. Countsure
visual: Compact tall egg-shaped male-read ink blob, two very unequal soft crest nubs, tiny ivory office collar only. One hand holds a SINGLE small old brass mechanical tally counter with a plain blank dial; other hand proudly presses the counter button. Wide feverishly delighted eyes, brows arched in revelation, narrow tilted OPEN mouth with two uneven UPPER teeth. He believes a count has settled an argument. No graphs, numbers, text, labcoat or machinery body.
personality: He can count everything except the reasons anybody agreed to be counted.
biography: Dr. Countsure uses his brass counter to turn HyperNorm neighbours into an encouraging total. The building recognises measured success and insufficient enthusiasm. The Men in Black request the first; Hunky and Dory keep raising the second. A dissonant card once asked what the number meant. He pressed the button twice, then noticed the resident asking was frightened. For the first time he put the counter down before offering an answer.
note: FrizzleBob: The number is correct. What it counts will be supplied later.
calls: We can improve that by counting again.
voice: English bright precise tenor, delighted certainty

name: Mrs. Betterbefore
visual: Female-read broad pear-shaped ink splat with a small pinned ink curl and modest lashes, dusty blue lace COLLAR accent only. Clutches a SINGLE small old oval handmirror whose glass is dull sepia, NO portrait/face inside it. Eyes turned upward in wistful certainty, one brow gentle and other defensive; long asymmetric CLOSED fond smile with one corner drooping. Other ink hand fondly polishes mirror edge with a fingertip. She knows the past was better because she has stopped inspecting it. No full dress, hair wig, framed scene or text.
personality: She remembers the past with admirable accuracy wherever it agrees with her.
biography: Mrs. Betterbefore polishes a sepia mirror until HyperNorm looks like a place where nothing ever went wrong. The Men in Black admire the stable picture; Hunky and Dory offer to remove distracting details. A contradictory card reminded her of the leaking roof. She nearly reported it, then remembered the neighbours who brought buckets. She still says everything was better. Lately she has been leaving buckets where people can find them.
note: FrizzleBob: Everything was better before. Apart from the parts that leaked.
calls: We never needed all these improvements.
voice: English warm alto, fond reminiscence hardening at the edges

name: Hugo Unanimous
visual: Wide flat-topped rounded male-read ink blob with three short floppy uneven crest lobes, one small faded coral bow tie. One hand grips a SINGLE tiny brass desk service bell, other hand slowly gives a reassuring THUMBS UP close to his body. Terribly strained broad CLOSED toothless smile, eyelids very uneven: one forced kindly wide eye, other sharp inspecting squint. The broad smile looks exhausting. No closed-eye grin, badges, voting slips, poster or second person.
personality: He welcomes every opinion that can be made to sound like his own.
biography: Hugo rings his little bell whenever the HyperNorm residents reach agreement, usually before anybody has finished speaking. The Men in Black value the quiet; Hunky and Dory value the minutes saying everyone was delighted. A dissonant card asked whether silence was a vote. Hugo smiled until his face hurt. One neighbour stayed behind to disagree kindly. He has not rung the bell about that conversation, and keeps hoping it will happen again.
note: FrizzleBob: Agreement was unanimous. Dissenting voices have been postponed.
calls: Any objections can be raised more quietly.
voice: English expansive baritone, over-reassuring smile audible in speech

name: Mr. Spotless
visual: Tall thin wavering male-read ink blob with one drooping side crest, tiny faded moss apron FRONT PATCH leaving goo dominant. Holds a SINGLE very small white feather duster at chest height, other dark ink hand meticulously inspects his own dark fingertip. One eye enormous and the other narrowed anxiously, forehead folds of self-suspicion, tiny crooked OPEN breath-catching mouth with ONE upper tooth inside. The compulsive purity tester is himself a blob of ink. No spotless white full-body costume, soap bubbles, microscope, literal cross-eyed gag or dirt cloud.
personality: He checks for contamination until even his own certainty looks suspicious.
biography: Mr. Spotless dusts the HyperNorm landing with a feather duster he will not allow anybody else to touch. He classifies thoughts as clean or in need of removal, although his own ink fingers complicate the inspection. The Men in Black approve the standard; Hunky and Dory ask him to extend it. A dissonant card stuck to his hand. When a neighbour helped peel it off without judging the stain, he found the method disturbingly effective.
note: FrizzleBob: The inspection is clean. The inspector remains under examination.
voice: English thin careful tenor, anxious pauses

name: Mira Hiddenhand
props: one tiny empty brass balance scale
visual: Female-read curvy asymmetrical upright crescent ink blob, tiny soft swept inkquiff and subtle lashes, muted mustard neck ribbon only. Holds ONE tiny old-fashioned brass balance scale with two clearly EMPTY shallow pans, simple thick readable geometry, no coins. Other ink hand open in a compact conjurer's flourish. Cool overconfident half-lidded eyes with white sclera, one amused lifted brow, skewed OPEN three-upper-tooth laugh. No witch hat, wand, extra floating props, symbols, graphs or human body.
personality: She trusts the balance most when nobody has put a need on either side.
biography: Mira carries an empty balance through HyperNorm and calls its perfect equilibrium a solution. The Men in Black appreciate how little it asks of them; Hunky and Dory suggest charging for the demonstration. A dissonant card brought a resident with nothing to trade. Mira first explained why the pans must stay level, then quietly offered to carry the residents bag. The balance tilted. Nothing terrible happened, which she finds theoretically inconvenient.
note: FrizzleBob: The balance is perfect. There is nothing in it.
calls: A need is not yet an offer.
voice: English smooth assured mezzo, amused confidence

name: Edwin Lockheart
visual: Broad round male-read ink blob with low rippling crest and a soft small burgundy scarf. Both ink hands tenderly cradle ONE small closed brass padlock against his chest like a cherished keepsake. Half-lidded dreamy white eyes glance at it with utter devotion, brows steeply tender rather than angry, tiny CLOSED puckered almost-kiss mouth. Sweet but faintly worried reverence, upright whole body. No key, door, cage, giant lock, heart symbols or pink human lips.
personality: He loves being safe so much that departure feels like a personal betrayal.
biography: Ewald holds his padlock as though HyperNorm were a promise that could be kept shut. The Men in Black encourage vigilance; Hunky and Dory have supplied further reasons to stay indoors. He used to report cards that suggested otherwise. One ambiguous card asked whom a locked door protects when a neighbour is outside. He has not unlocked every fear. He has, however, begun checking that nobody is left on the landing before bedtime.
note: FrizzleBob: He keeps danger out. Kindly let the neighbours in first.
calls: We are quite safe in here.
Is everybody on the correct side?
voice: English soft low baritone, dreamy affection mixed with worry
